verification.environment: isolated Node runtime using byte-identical authored files before commit

observed_state.blocker: Vercel account build-rate limit prevented immutable deployment verification

proved: Operations-only changes can be admitted as sentinel attempts while capacity is blocked.
Application, configuration, workflow, unknown, empty, and ambiguous change sets fail closed while capacity is blocked.
A single application deployment is admitted only when capacity is represented as available and exact-commit verification is explicitly required.
Equivalent changed-path sets produce deterministic evidence digests.
privacy_boundary: No credentials, private chat content, medical material, payment logic, or personal identifiers were added.
